lessons: A human must fix the phase3-continue seed on main through the operator recovery path. This ticket forbids editing seeds, and the seed fails review because its stated idiom conflicts with its Context.
Check whether the 19.L/19.P3 plan text produced the bad idiom or the successor embedding. If it did, fix the plan first and regenerate the seed. Do not hand-edit tickets/phase3-continue/ticket.md.
The successor seed must embed a seeding test that is already merged when the seed is admitted. Do not point it at tests/test_seeded_phase3_01.py, which does not exist yet at seeding time.

Before rerunning, run `git rev-parse main:tickets/phase3-continue/ticket.md` and compare it with the blob in phase2-exit/checks.json. Rerun Implement only after the blob changes and the requisition_review snag no longer applies to it.
On rerun, keep tickets/ out of the branch diff (AC4). Author only tests/test_phase2_exit.py and tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py, and pin the seed sizes in the test against the corrected blob.
